label: Minimum wage (МРЗ): 660 € proposed, 660 €+ possible
text: Social affairs minister Nataliya Efremova said on 26 Oct that a figure above the drafted €660 is "most likely possible" if budget revenues allow; the Council for Tripartite Partnership discussed the €660-from-1-Jan-2027 ordinance on 23 Oct without unanimity, and the public consultation on the ordinance (ID 12802) closes on 28 Oct 2026.
